title: Workspaces with fewer than 2 admins
recommendation: Assign at least two workspace admins (preferably via a security group) to avoid orphan risk.

title: Items with no activity in the last 7 day(s)
recommendation: Archive or delete confirmed inactive items after validating their business retention requirements.

title: Sensitivity label coverage
recommendation: Apply sensitivity labels to semantic models, reports, lakehouses, and warehouses; enforce via tenant setting and Purview integration.

title: Workspaces following documented naming convention
recommendation: Document and enforce a naming convention combining domain, environment, and purpose (for example, `<domain>-<env>-<purpose>`).

title: Sharing events in last 7 day(s)
recommendation: Review high-volume sharers; enforce sharing via Apps + security groups rather than ad-hoc per-report sharing.

title: Workspaces with content but no activity in last 7 day(s)
recommendation: Confirm the owner; if the workspace is no longer used, archive it to reduce attack surface and capacity load.

title: Fabric Capacity Metrics app is installed
recommendation: Install the Microsoft Fabric Capacity Metrics app so capacity CU, throttling, and overload events can be monitored over time - it is the primary tool for diagnosing capacity health and right-sizing.

title: Endorsement (Certified / Promoted) coverage of content
recommendation: Endorse trusted datasets/reports as Promoted, and the authoritative ones as Certified, so consumers can tell governed content from ad-hoc content.

title: Production workspaces without endorsed semantic models
recommendation: Certify the authoritative semantic models in production workspaces so downstream reports build on governed, trusted data.
